tools.name: techwrit_review
tools.description: Review technical documentation against the account's saved style rules, terminology, and glossary. Returns severity-ranked findings (Critical, Important, Minor).

input.description: The text to process — the document, source code, or prompt for this mode.

docType.description: Optional document-type context, e.g. "API reference", "User guide", "Release notes".

audience.description: Optional target audience; tailors vocabulary and detail level.

framework.description: Optional output framework/structure hint for the mode.

format.description: Set to "suggestions" to receive a structured JSON array of findings (each with severity, original, replacement, reason) instead of prose.
